6062ab08875251fe16db415a58b6607e2a573a2d.summary: A Netresec blog post by Erik Hjelmvik, published 9 June 2025, shows CapLoader's Port Independent Protocol Identification feature identifying the C2 protocol used by the PureLogs Stealer malware in a PCAP from a public malware traffic analysis collection. The protocol detection was added in CapLoader 2.0. The post lists indicators of compromise, which are not reproduced here. No threat actor, sector, country or CVE is named.

tools.q: CapLoader includes a feature for Port Independent Protocol Identification
used by the PureLogs Stealer malware.

techniques.q: CapLoader includes a feature for Port Independent Protocol Identification

6041000c93415cc8929b14f9a1c175c4a5302784.summary: Index page for the QakBot malware family (also called QBot, Qakbot or Pinkslipbot), archived 2026-04-05 from a Fraunhofer FKIE malware-family reference entry. It describes QakBot as a modular information stealer active since 2007, historically known as a banking Trojan and a loader. Most of the page is a long list of titled third-party reports, blog posts and takedown notices dated 2009 to 2024, with no analysis of its own. It is not a threat report, so no facts are recorded.
